CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_bing_connections (
 client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 api_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 site_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
 status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok',
 last_error VARCHAR(500),
 connected_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 connected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_bing_connections_api_key CHECK (api_key LIKE 'v1:%'),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_bing_connections_status CHECK (status IN ('ok','invalid')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_bing_connections_site_url CHECK (site_url ~ '^https?://')
)
